tools.name: gilbert_openings
tools.description: Use for "what is opening in Gilbert", "new restaurants in Gilbert AZ", "is <name> coming to Gilbert", "what is opening near SanTan Village / Agritopia / Downtown". Returns places from the Town of Gilbert liquor-license list and county permits with what the record says (filed, confirmed or already op

tools.name: gilbert_events
tools.description: Use for "things to do in Gilbert this weekend", "events in Gilbert today", "free events in Gilbert", or events on given dates. Returns events in Gilbert, AZ from the Town of Gilbert calendar and Eventbrite with date, time, venue, free flag and a link. Without dates it returns the next 7 days.

tools.name: gilbert_best_of
tools.description: Use for "best brunch in Gilbert", "top coffee shops in Gilbert AZ", "best breweries / Mexican food / dentists / gyms / HVAC / pool service in Gilbert". Ranks places in the Gilbert First directory by Google rating, then review count, with a minimum number of reviews (default 50). Ratings are Google's

tools.name: gilbert_council_watch
tools.description: Use for "what is on the Gilbert council agenda", "when does the council vote on <name>'s liquor license", rezonings and development items. Returns upcoming Town Council meetings, the liquor, zoning and development items on published agendas, and liquor licenses waiting for a vote.

tools.name: gilbert_business_lookup
tools.description: Use for one named business in Gilbert, AZ: address, phone, website, Google rating with review count and as-of date, its directory page, and whether it is on the openings tracker. Returns not_found when the business is not in the directory.
